topic: What If You Dug a Hole Through the Earth and Jumped In?
header: What if you jumped through the Earth?

beats.narration: If you dug a hole straight through the Earth and jumped in, you'd pop out the other side in about thirty-eight minutes... and then fall right back in.

shots.scene_description: Spinning clay Earth, camera pushes in
Character jumps into a hole in the ground

beats.narration: First, you'd have to dig through almost thirteen thousand kilometres of rock.

shots.scene_description: Cutaway Earth with a glowing line straight through the middle
Cutaway rotating

beats.narration: The deepest hole humans have ever dug only reached about twelve kilometres. Today it's just a small rusty cap in the ground.

shots.scene_description: Ground with a small capped borehole
Earth from space with a tiny scratch

beats.narration: Below the crust is the mantle: hot rock that slowly flows, like incredibly thick toffee.

shots.scene_description: Camera drifts over the glowing mantle layer
Close-up of the mantle

beats.narration: Then the outer core, an ocean of liquid metal, and finally the inner core, about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

shots.scene_description: Glowing orange outer core
Blazing inner core

beats.narration: But let's say you had a magic, heat-proof tube, with all the air sucked out. You jump.

shots.scene_description: A glass tube slides through the cutaway
Character leaps into the tube

beats.narration: Gravity pulls you faster and faster. By the centre, you're moving about as fast as a rocket heading into orbit.

shots.scene_description: Character falling down the tube
Dot racing down the tunnel in the cutaway

beats.narration: And right at the centre, you'd feel completely weightless, because the whole planet is pulling you equally in every direction.

shots.scene_description: Character floating at the centre, arms out
Arrows pulling in from all sides

beats.narration: Then you start slowing down, rising up towards the other side, until you pop out, about thirty-eight minutes after you jumped.

shots.scene_description: Dot rising towards the far side
Character popping out of a hole on the other side

beats.narration: But here's the crazy part. Unless someone grabs you, you'd fall straight back down and do it all again... forever. A human yo-yo.

shots.scene_description: Character falling back down
Dot bouncing back and forth through the Earth

beats.narration: And if you jumped in from the UK, you'd pop out in the Pacific Ocean, near New Zealand.

shots.scene_description: Globe turning from the UK to the far side
Character popping out of the ocean with a splash

beats.narration: So... would you jump? Tell me in the comments.

shots.scene_description: Character waving on the Earth
Character waving
